=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/guard_differential.py: around line 736; full summary line at lines 772-778
  PROBLEM: When `report.trees` is empty (no hook changed), the new code path prints `::warning::GUARD_DIFFERENTIAL verifier_change …` lines, then prints `status=skipped reason=no-hook-change`, and returns before reaching the multi-field summary line that carries `verifier_changes=<n>`.
  WHY: It is not a correctness bug for the verifier itself (the `::warning::GUARD_DIFFERENTIAL verifier_change` lines still surface the security-boundary changes), but the documented output contract for the summary line does not match what the verifier emits in the no-hook-change path. Any downstream log parser that splits on `verifier_changes=` and assumes the field is present on every `status=…` line will silently miss it for the `status=skipped` case. The doc either needs to clarify that `verifier_changes=<n>` is omitted on the `status=skipped` path, or the summary line needs to include the field there too (e.g. by moving the `if not report.trees: … return` block to after the missing-corpus and intended-loosening loops, or by emitting a minimal `status=skipped … verifier_changes=<n>` summary before the early return).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/guard_differential.py:727-736
  PROBLEM: When report.trees is empty (no hook changed), the function prints verifier_change warnings (lines 728-733) then returns early at line 736 without printing the summary line that carries verifier_changes=<n> (line 775).
  WHY: The agents.md documentation states "a GUARD_DIFFERENTIAL status=<pass|fail|skipped|error> … verifier_changes=<n> summary" is printed, implying the summary line accompanies every status value including skipped. A downstream log parser expecting verifier_changes in every GUARD_DIFFERENTIAL status line would not find it in status=skipped lines. The test test_cli_reports_a_verifier_script_change_without_failing expects "status=skipped reason=no-hook-change" which is consistent with the current behavior, but the documentation is not.
